preview.observedMessage: Staging route is disabled. No action has been sent.

limitations: Hosted preview is disabled and has no configured data transport or environment credential access.
Real Access login on the preview hostname is unverified; prior owner verification was a different production-hosted read-only probe.
Browser end-to-end used a local synthetic Access gateway and embedded SQL, not hosted browser-to-Railway traffic.
Preview snapshot intentionally omits the production website and must never be merged to main.
Staging browser API remains synthetic-config only; real hostname/issuer/AUD and signed receiver integration need a reviewed scoped adapter.
Separate Access app/policy, staging-only keys, fresh fixtures and bounded runtime grants are required before hosted activation.
No additional service, domain, database or resource allocation was created; incremental build/request billing was not measured.
